games.title: Secret Hitler
games.description: A social deduction game of political intrigue. Liberals must find and stop the Secret Hitler before it's too late.

games.title: Code Names
games.description: Two teams race to find their agents using one-word clues from their spymaster. Careful — one wrong guess could end it all.

games.title: Ticket To Ride
games.description: A cross-country race to claim train routes and complete your secret destination tickets first.

games.title: Family Feud
games.description: Survey says! Team up, buzz in on your phones, and guess the top answers on the big board before you strike out.

games.title: Coup
games.description: Bluff, challenge, and eliminate your way to the throne. Claim characters you don't have, call out liars, and be the last influence standing.

games.title: Quixx
games.description: A fast-paced dice game. Lock in the best combinations across four colored rows before the dice turn against you.

games.title: Wavelength
games.description: A mind-reading party game. Give a clue to steer your team toward the secret spot on the dial — the closer you land, the more you score.

games.title: Catan
games.description: Trade resources, build roads and settlements, and race to 10 points on the island of Catan.

games.title: Cover Your Assets
games.description: Collect sets of matching cards, then swap and steal your way to the biggest stash before anyone else covers theirs.

games.title: Skull King
games.description: A pirate-themed trick-taking game. Bid on how many tricks you'll win each round, then sail as close to your prediction as you can.

games.title: Exploding Kittens
games.description: A card game of kitty combat. Draw cards, avoid the exploding kitten, and use your hand to sabotage everyone else's odds.

games.title: Boggle
games.description: Shake the grid and race the clock to find as many hidden words as you can before time runs out.

games.title: Bananagrams
games.description: A speedy word-building game. Race to build your own crossword grid before anyone else uses up all the tiles.

games.title: Scattergories
games.description: Beat the clock and your opponents by naming an item in each category that starts with the same letter — no repeats allowed.

games.title: Farkle
games.description: A push-your-luck dice game. Bank your points each turn or roll again for more — bust, and you lose it all.

games.title: Flip 7
games.description: A push-your-luck card game. Flip cards to build the biggest total without busting — collect seven uniques and score big.

games.title: Cards Against Humanity
games.description: A horribly offensive party game. Fill in the blank with the worst card in your hand and hope the judge has terrible taste.

games.title: New Phone Who Dis?
games.description: A raunchy party game about ridiculous texts. Match the funniest response to the prompt and hope your friends have the same terrible sense of humor.
